question_as_asked: Please list the countries of the gas stations with transactions taken place in June, 2013.

question.question_text: Please list the countries of the gas stations with transactions taken place in June, 2013.
question.evidence_text: June 2013 refers to '201306'; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month;

executed_sql:
SELECT gasstations.country
FROM transactions_1k
JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.gasstationid = gasstations.gasstationid
JOIN yearmonth ON transactions_1k.customerid = yearmonth.customerid
WHERE yearmonth.date LIKE '201306'
